description: Golden dataset for the AI chart setup reviewer. VALID charts are setups the trader would take by their rules: real closed trades (outcomePct from journal) or textbook examples that later failed (outcomePct null) — good process, bad outcome. INVALID charts are scanner candidates the trader rejected on manual review. All images captured via TradingView Bar Replay; entryDate is the last trading day visible in the image (metadata is computed up to and including that date, nothing later).

labels.processLabel: User's own judgment of the setup, independent of outcome: VALID | MARGINAL | INVALID. Assigned before seeing AI verdicts to avoid outcome bias.
labels.outcomePct: Realized gain/loss percent computed as (exit - entry) / entry * 100, from the trade journal. Null for charts with no trade.
